Company Profile
ABOUT ALLIED INDUSTRIES

Precision rivet manufacturer trusted by India's top OEMs for over 25 years.

Crafting Precision. Engineering Trust. Since 1998.

For nearly thirty years, Allied Industries has been synonymous with uncompromised engineering. Established in Delhi in 1998, we began a journey to redefine how global industries secure their most critical connections through premium Metal and Contact Rivets.

We don’t just manufacture; we master the details. Our products are precision-engineered using only the finest grade base materials and the industry's latest machinery. This relentless pursuit of quality is backed by a highly specialized, ultra-modern facility divided into dedicated hubs—including advanced R & D, automated warehousing, and comprehensive after-sales service. Each division is managed by veteran professionals who bring decades of technical expertise to the table.

Our legacy is built on the sturdy construction and flawless dimensions of our products. As we look to the future, Allied Industries remains dedicated to innovating alongside our global partners, ensuring that our components continue to power optimum performance across the globe.

🏆 ISO 9001:2000 Certified

Our quality management system ensures consistent, traceable quality across every product batch. All products comply with national and international quality standards.

Our Infrastructure

Our state-of-the-art facility covers manufacturing, distribution, quality control, warehousing & packaging, and sales & marketing divisions:

  • Manufacturing & Production Unit
  • Research & Development (R&D)
  • In-house Quality Testing Lab
  • Warehousing & Packaging Division
  • Sales & Marketing Unit
  • After Sales Service & Support

Machinery: lathe machines, welding machines, cutting machines — operated by skilled professionals with wide industry knowledge.

Our Products
RIVETS FOR EVERY
DEMANDING APPLICATION

Precision-manufactured to national and international standards. Available in comprehensive materials, dimensions and head profiles.

Category 01

Metal Rivets

Manufactured to national and international quality standards. Known for optimal strength and durability, used in automotive, electrical, and industrial applications. Available in copper, silver alloys, pure silver, mild steel, and aluminium.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Semi Tubular Rivets

Manufactured with utmost precision and accuracy. Available in copper, silver alloys, pure silver, mild steel and aluminium. Facility available to produce a variety of dimensions.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Trimmed Rivets

Designed for non-round head shapes. We specialise in producing trimmed rivets for head shapes other than round ones with precision and accuracy.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Straight Head Rivets

Maximum contact area design — particularly suited for wiring harness applications. Manufactured with consistent head geometry and shank dimensions.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Double Head Shank Rivets

Produced with very close tolerances as given in customer drawings. Ideal for applications demanding precise dimensional accuracy and superior structural strength.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Formed Rivets

Designed for head shapes other than round, manufactured to very close tolerances specified by customers. Custom profiles available on request.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Copper Rivets

Wide assortment made using ETP copper wires as per customer challenging specifications. High conductivity and excellent corrosion resistance.

Category 02

Contact Rivets

Manufactured by cold heading process. Shank made soft for easy riveting while head is work-hardened. Available in various dimensions with economically priced composite construction.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Trimetal Contact Rivets

Economical compared to solid silver contacts without compromising quality. AgCdO / AgNi / Ag999 layer bonded with ETP Copper on both sides. Ideal for high-cycle switching applications.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Weldable Button Contact Rivets

Projection weldable contacts with AgCdO / AgNi on Nickel, CuNi, and Steel base. Precision manufactured for reliable electrical contact performance in switchgear.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Bimetal Contact Rivets

Contact layer is normally half the thickness of the head. Variation on ratio possible within practical limits. Contact layer can be AgCdO, AgNi, AgSnO, Ag999, etc.

🔍 Click to enlarge

Disc Contact Rivets

Available in all alloy compositions as per customer specifications. Disc type contacts for demanding electrical contact applications requiring high reliability.
